title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap **More info** on an item on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: Update: **Trump lands in Shenzhen**, greeted by **Xi** at the airport, ahead of Thursday's first-ever **Trump–Xi–Putin** meeting
items.summary_md: Xi and Putin held their 50th meeting on the APEC sidelines Wednesday.

items.headline_md: After US strikes on Iran's **Qeshm Island**, Iran hits **Bahrain** and a **Kuwaiti base** used by US forces; the **Houthis** fire cruise missiles at **Riyadh**
items.summary_md: The Houthi fire followed a major Saudi-backed coalition air attack on the group's missiles and drones, and a UAE state oil tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline_md: The Pentagon tells Ukraine's backers that **deep strikes inside Russia** don't work; **Germany** calls that view "quite stupid"
items.summary_md: Britain sided with Germany at the NATO meeting, and a Dutch firm says seven of its Ruta cruise missiles hit the Kerch Bridge.

items.headline_md: Israel's Knesset elects **Matan Kahana**, a Netanyahu opponent, as speaker by **66–52**
items.summary_md: That gives Netanyahu's opponents control of the legislative agenda while coalition talks continue.

items.headline_md: Mongolia's president **Ukhnaa Khurelsukh** says he will resign amid abuse-of-power and bribery allegations
items.summary_md: Parliament has the final say on whether to accept it.

items.headline_md: Update: **Nvidia** beats with **$115.8B** in revenue (+103%) and guides **$130B** for next quarter; the board says it won't bring back **Jensen Huang**
items.summary_md: Interim CEO Colette Kress raised next fiscal year's growth outlook to about 75%, from 70%.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic** prices its IPO tonight and is likely to go **above its $70–$78 range**, sources say; trading starts **Thu** as **ANT**
items.summary_md: It is offering 825 million shares, worth up to about $1.4T at the top of the range.

items.headline_md: **Target** posts its best sales growth in five years and **raises its outlook**
items.summary_md: Comparable sales rose 5.6% vs. 3.8% expected, and full-year EPS guidance is now $10.65–$11.40.

items.headline_md: **Lowe's** beats on **$22.76B** in sales and nudges up its full-year outlook despite a slow housing market
items.summary_md: Online sales rose 17.4%; about $250M in tariff refunds added 34 cents to EPS.

items.headline_md: Google Play's **Best of Play 2026**: **Arknights: Endfield** wins Best Game; **Subway Surfers City** wins **Best Pick Up & Play**
items.summary_md: Other winners: Sea of Stars (Story), Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor (Indie), Warframe (Multiplayer), Zenless Zone Zero (Ongoing).

items.headline_md: **GTA 6** leads **The Game Awards 2026** with **8 nominations**, a day before it launches **Thu Nov 19**
items.summary_md: Best Mobile nominees: Arknights: Endfield, Monster Hunter Outlanders, Neverness to Everness, Pokémon Champions and Where Winds Meet; the show is Dec 10.

items.headline_md: Sensor Tower: South Korea's mobile game **downloads fell 28%** from 2021 to 2026 while **revenue held near $5B**
items.summary_md: Publishers are leaning on retention and casual spin-offs; hybrid-casual maker **Supercent** grew overseas revenue 97% in Q1–Q3.

items.headline_md: **Netflix** confirms **layoffs** in its games division after a restructuring
items.summary_md: It says its games strategy is unchanged; Next Games is now its only first-party studio.

items.headline_md: A UK tribunal throws out the **£2B PlayStation Store** class action over Sony's **30% cut**
items.summary_md: It found players have real alternatives (discs, rival consoles), unlike in the earlier App Store ruling.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still no public repo. The r/decomps new page shows no lifter announcement (it does show a new mod rule: "No Switch 2 repo links at all!"), and GitHub searches for Wii U lifter/recomp turn up only single-game projects (BOTWRecomp for macOS, updated Nov 17; Tekken Tag 2 Wii U port) and the older brandraft-exp/wiiu-recomp, not a general lifter. Watch list: [Quiver Launcher](https://github.com/tgeorgiadis/quiver-launcher/releases) is still on 4.0.0-beta.7 (5:27 AM AZ Monday), not stable. [Longshot](https://git.magicbean.dev/MagicBeanDev/Longshot/releases) has only nightlies since v3.0.0-rc.7 (latest nightly-484 at 1:48 AM AZ today). Boxshelf (v1.82.0-beta.14, Nov 14) and NX2navi (v0.12.0, Nov 14) have nothing new, and NotRexed's last public activity was Nov 13.

items.headline_md: Switch 2 on Android: **Banana Native v0.3.40** runs **10 Switch 2 games**, including **Mario Kart World** and **Donkey Kong Bananza**
items.summary_md: Shaders now compile in the background as you play; you need your own console dump and a flagship phone with about 12–16GB of RAM.

items.headline_md: PS5: original-Xbox emulator **XPSemu Alpha 3.6** adds GPU-powered **AI texture upscaling** and EvolutionX dashboard support
items.summary_md: It also fixes OutRun 2 SP (Chihiro) booting and Silent Hill 2's pause-screen smear; it needs a jailbroken PS5 (kstuff).

items.headline_md: PS3 recomp: **Asura's Wrath** gets a native PC port, **v1.0**, made by statically recompiling the PowerPC code
items.summary_md: Up to 4K and 120 fps with no emulator or PS3 firmware; you build it from your own copy of the European release.

items.headline_md: **DOOM Recomp 1.1.0** (DOOM 2016 natively on Apple Silicon) fixes **macOS 26** and adds the **GOG** version
items.summary_md: Posted at 8:14 PM AZ Tuesday, a day after 1.0.0; you need your own Windows copy.

items.headline_md: 3DS emulator **Azahar 2127.0** reaches release candidate, with all-in-one **ROM bundles** and a faster iOS interpreter
items.summary_md: Per-game settings arrive on Android; the stable release isn't out yet.

items.headline_md: Update: **The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** reviews are in: **75%** on Rotten Tomatoes (80 reviews), **56** on Metacritic
items.summary_md: It opens Fri Nov 20 as the weekend's big new release.

items.headline_md: First reactions call Fincher and Tarantino's **The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth** an "absolute triumph"
items.summary_md: Brad Pitt's sequel opens only in IMAX on Nov 25, then streams on Netflix Dec 23.

items.headline_md: Small releases are growing: **Club Kid** rose **87%** on 27 screens ($28,002 per screen) and **I Play Rocky** rose 46% before it goes wide Friday
items.summary_md: Paper Tiger still had the weekend's best per-screen average.

items.headline_md: Ron Howard says a **Grinch** sequel with **Jim Carrey** goes ahead only with a great script, and there's no script yet
items.summary_md: Universal and Imagine are developing it; Howard says it would still be live action.

items.headline_md: OpenAI launches **GPT-6.2 Astra** (frontier) and **GPT-6.2 Sol** (everyday) in ChatGPT, Codex and the API
items.summary_md: Astra's API prices are 20% lower than GPT-6 Astra's ($8 in / $40 out per million tokens); Sol keeps GPT-6.1 Sol's prices.

items.headline_md: DeepMind spinout **Isomorphic Labs** raises **$5B** to take its AI-designed drugs into clinical trials
items.summary_md: Greenoaks and Sequoia co-led, six months after a $2.1B Series B.

items.headline_md: The Trump administration plans to name **Nvidia** and more than two dozen firms US AI **"national champions"**
items.summary_md: Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic are expected on the list, with faster export licenses and federal financing.

items.headline_md: Tencent's **Hy4 flash** has 224B parameters (12B active), a **1M-token** context and costs about **$0.07 per million input tokens**
items.summary_md: That's Tencent's own pricing figure.

items.headline_md: Apple changes **App Store prices** in 5 countries on **Dec 3**, and adds **California sales tax** on some app categories from **Jan 1**
items.summary_md: Botswana, Colombia, Egypt, Rwanda and Türkiye change; US shelf prices don't, but California buyers may pay more with tax.

items.headline_md: Ads: **AppLovin** quietly stopped letting publishers create new waterfall lines outside its own **MAX** mediation
items.summary_md: New Unity LevelPlay apps can't add AppLovin demand at all; AdMob apps can still use it through bidding.

items.headline_md: A hack of **Optimizely** loaded card-skimming and crypto-stealing code on **178** organizations' sites, including CNN, BBC and Zoom
items.summary_md: It also pushed iOS exploit kits; anyone who entered a card on those sites on Nov 16 should check statements and update iOS.

items.headline_md: Futures at 2:53 AM AZ: **S&P 500 +0.62%**, **Nasdaq 100 +1.17%**, **Dow +0.28%**, lifted by Nvidia
items.summary_md: Fed minutes come out today, and Anthropic prices its IPO this evening.

items.headline_md: **Nvidia ~$160.14** premarket at 5:06 AM AZ, up about **3%** from Tuesday's $155.46 close
items.summary_md: Reuters also had CoreWeave up 6.5% and Nebius up 8.1% early.

items.headline_md: **Gold ~$3,763** at 4:56 AM AZ, down about **2.5%** to its lowest in more than a year as the dollar hits a 19-month high
items.summary_md: Miners like Newmont and Freeport were lower premarket.
Supply-surplus worries are outweighing tanker attacks in the Gulf.
Crypto changes are vs. the start of the UTC day.

sections.title: Weather
sections.body_md:
No ice storm or tornado threat for the St. Louis area in the next 7 days (NWS/SPC): no active NWS alerts at either point ([NWS alerts](https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=38.7875,-90.6299)), SPC Days 1–3 show no severe areas near Missouri, and NWS St. Louis lists no watches or advisories. Update on Saturday: SPC's Day 4–8 outlook now puts the isolated severe chance Sat–Sun over the **central and southern Plains**, with confidence too low to draw a risk area ([SPC Day 4–8](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/exper/day4-8/)). Locally, NWS expects highs in the upper 60s to about 70 through Saturday, then a cold front with rain Saturday night into Sunday (40% / 30%), and a cold snap next week with highs in the 40s and lows in the 20s; Tuesday night has a 20% chance of light snow or a rain-snow mix with little or no accumulation, so no ice expected ([NWS St. Louis discussion](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=LSX&issuedby=LSX&product=AFD)). The LSX Hazardous Weather Outlook wasn't available through the NWS API this morning.

items.headline_md: **St. Peters**: mostly sunny and warmer, high near **65°**, low around **44°** tonight, 0% rain chance
items.summary_md: South wind 5–12 mph, gusting to about 20 mph late morning into the afternoon.

items.headline_md: **Berkeley**: mostly sunny, high near **65°**, low around **45°** tonight, 0% rain chance
items.summary_md: South wind 6–10 mph; a little river fog was reported early but isn't expected to spread.

items.headline_md: Microsoft, FAA, Chase, NSA, Apple: **why everything seems to be breaking at once**
items.summary_md: A clear look at whether a week of big outages is sabotage or just brittle, AI-strained systems; Apple blamed its own outage Tuesday on an internal update, not an attack.
